My favorite Vietnamese restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City
Sep 2026
This is hands down my favorite place for Vietnamese food in Ho Chi Minh City. Everything I’ve tried has been absolutely delicious, with authentic flavors and beautifully prepared dishes. The service is incredible — the staff are always friendly, attentive, and welcoming. And the restaurant itself is gorgeous, with such a beautiful and relaxing atmosphere. It’s one of those places I genuinely enjoy coming back to again and again. If you’re looking for amazing Vietnamese food in a beautiful setting with excellent service, I highly recommend Quan Bui Garden. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Convenient, quick, and delicious!
Sep 2026 • Couples
I had a wonderful experience at Quán Bụi Restaurant. I came here with my friend and enjoyed our meal inside the Vietnamese-style restaurant. It was great that we could order both Vietnamese and Thai dishes. We tried many delicious dishes, especially Pad Thai and mango sticky rice. I highly recommend the mango sticky rice — it was absolutely amazing. The staff member named Quyên was very friendly, attentive, and sincere. She took great care of us throughout our meal. I will definitely come back again on my next visit!

Experience at Quán Bụi garden 3
Aug 2026 • Couples
I am very satisfied with the experience at Quán Bụi Restaurant. The space is beautifully designed, cozy, and has a traditional Vietnamese yet modern feel, creating a comfortable dining atmosphere. Dishes such as steamed chicken with clams, braised pork and eggs, crispy fried squid with vegetables and tamarind sauce, and Quán Bụi spring rolls are all beautifully presented, rich in flavor, and easy to eat. In particular, Đá Me Quán Bụi is a quite interesting drink to have with a meal. Employee Bui Thi Hong served very enthusiastically, cheerfully, and attentively. Overall, this is a worthwhile place to visit if you want to enjoy Vietnamese dishes in a beautiful and tidy setting.
